answer: Let the staking collateral C be locked in a zero-knowledge verifiable delay orchard, where any attempted identity multiplication triggers a subgame-perfect slashing penalty S > C. In this decentralized ocean of validators, a dynamic opportunity-cost bond enforces a strict capital barrier, isolating malicious agents on a utility-deprived island. Because the expected payoff of generating N Sybil identities is U(N) = N * [R - (C + S)] < 0, the unique Nash equilibrium converges to honest participation, proving robust Sybil resistance.
